text:
Maria Lopez: Heads-up: were publishing the DevTool deep-dive tomorrow 10:00 AM PT. Need owned-channel plan: tweet variants, LinkedIn, changelog, community post, ES/FR localizations, sales one-pager, influencer/partner outreach. Who's in?
Samir Patel: I can do the tweet + LinkedIn. Need final headline + URL.
Evan Chen: I'll handle changelog + sales one-pager. Need 3 highlight bullets and any numbers by 8:00 AM PT.
Courtney Blake: I'll do ES/FR translations by 9:00 AM PT. No JP this release.
Jena (publish-bot): Publish job scheduled: 2026-06-16 17:00:00 UTC (10:00 AM PT). Draft: https://blog.redwood.inference/devtool-release
Design Bot: Can produce hero 1200x628 + thumbnail by 6:00 AM PT if copy is final.
Evan Chen: From eng: latency improvement up to 30% (batch/seq dependent). Throughput ~1.4x in lab. Use conservative phrasing and link benchmarks.
Samir Patel: Using "up to 30%". Marketing wants UTMs: utm_source=owned_social, utm_campaign=devtool_launch, utm_medium={channel}.
Samir Patel: Draft tweets:
Variant A: Ship faster with Redwood DevTool  up to 30% lower inference latency and better throughput. Blog + benchmarks  https://blog.redwood.inference/devtool-release?utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=devtool_launch&utm_medium=tweet
Variant B (card): Ship faster. Run models cheaper. Redwood DevTool cuts inference latency by up to 30% and boosts throughput  hands-on breakdown in our new blog. [link with UTMs]
Courtney Blake: I'll localize both tweets and the LinkedIn post; will keep metric phrasing exact.
Evan Chen: Sales one-pager bullets:
- What: DevTool  inference optimizations for production workloads.
- Why: reduces median latency, increases throughput, lowers per-token cost.
- Wins: up to 30% latency reduction, ~1.4x throughput in internal tests, supports hosted/dedicated/private.
- CTA: Try hosted API or request Dedicated trial.
Maria Lopez: Add 2-3 example use-cases and a short product quote.
Evan Chen: Use quote: "DevTool gives engineering teams predictable, production-grade performance  without rewrites."
Samir Patel: LinkedIn draft: Today were announcing Redwood DevTool  production-ready inference optimizations to help teams ship faster and cut costs. In tests, DevTool delivers up to 30% latency reduction and improves throughput across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Read more & see benchmarks. [link] #RedwoodInference #MLInfra
Design Bot: Confirming small "up to 30%" stat badge on hero image?
Maria Lopez: Confirmed  tasteful only.
Maria Lopez: Outreach: 6 influencers + 4 partners. Need personalized outreach at publish time.
Evan Chen: Ill draft outreach templates; Samir can send from company handle.
Samir Patel: I'll prepare #announcements copy: "New: Redwood DevTool  up to 30% lower inference latency. Blog + benchmarks: [link]"
Maria Lopez: Product + Legal must approve by 7:30 AM PT. Evan please chase.
Evan Chen: Pinged Product & Legal.
Courtney Blake: Localization files will be in /marketing/localization/devtool_launch/ by 9:00 AM PT.
Maria Lopez: Great work team, flag if anything slips. :heart:
